files.description: Hospital admissions (260 rows): admission_id (whole number), age (years, whole number; about 5% empty), ward (cardiology, oncology, maternity, orthopedics or neurology; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), stay_days (whole number; about 3% empty), charge (two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: Replace every missing value in the admissions table by 0 and give back the completed table. `result` should be the table with all original columns, in file order.
intended_computation: Fill the missing ages, stays and charges with 0 and return all 260 rows with the five columns unchanged otherwise.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the fill with the in-place flag returns None, so the stored answer is empty; 3.x returns the filled table

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
